Specification: This module defines a small helper operator F that returns the one-element subsequence from position 2 to position 2 of an input sequence. The specification then states two separate assumptions asserting that applying F to two different sequence constructions with an overridden second element yields the same first element as applying F to the explicit tuple <<0, 1, 0, 0>>. The file is a compact semantic check about sequence construction, function override, and subsequence extraction; it does not model a transition system, fault model, temporal behavior, fairness, or proofs.
